about_the_game:
In Etherland Tactics, embark on a journey with a diverse group of characters who, after a mysterious event during a space expedition, find themselves stranded on a planet where a strange energy makes magic and fantastic creatures possible. Uncover the secrets of this fascinating world as you dive into a captivating narrative, face challenging tactical battles, and explore deep character customization. Prove you are the best strategist in Etherland Tactics!

Two years ago, a group of space explorers vanished after losing contact while passing near a mysterious planet. Since then, no trace of them has been found. Now, Rex, the son of two of the missing explorers, has just turned 20 and, after dedicating the last two years of his life to training, is ready to begin his own expedition in search of answers about his parents’ fate.

Accompanied by Rebeca, a brilliant engineer, and a team of explorers, Rex sets off toward the enigmatic planet. However, the expedition takes an unexpected turn when they are drawn in by a mysterious energy that transports them to a fantastical world. There, as they face new challenges, they begin to realize that the events that brought them to this place may be connected to the disappearance of the original group.

  • Turn-Based Tactical Combat: Strategic and dynamic, perfect for fans of the genre.

  • Advanced Class System: Customize your character with a high level of personalization.

  • Customizable Abilities: Modify each ability to make your character truly unique.

  • Immersive Exploration: Move freely through environments outside of combat, diving into rich and detailed exploration.

  • Memorable Characters: Meet charismatic characters with abilities and personalities that enrich both the narrative and the gameplay.

  • Engaging Storyline: Follow an exciting plot, form new bonds, and forge your own path in an unforgettable journey.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2018
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 support, x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 support, ARMv7 or ARMv8 CPU Example: Intel Core 2 Duo E8200, AMD FX-4100, Raspberry Pi 4
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full OpenGL 3.3 support Example: Intel HD Graphics 2500 (Ivy Bridge), AMD Radeon R5 Graphics (Kaveri)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2020
  • Processor: x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 support, ARMv7 or ARMv8 CPU Example: Intel Core i5-6600K, AMD Ryzen 5 1600, Raspberry Pi 5 with overclocking
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full OpenGL 4.6 support Example: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 (Kepler), AMD Radeon HD 7750 (GCN 1.0)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 support, x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 support, ARMv8 CPU Example: Intel Core 2 Duo E8200, AMD FX-4100, Snapdragon X Elite
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full OpenGL 3.3 support Example: Intel HD Graphics 2500 (Ivy Bridge), AMD Radeon R5 Graphics (Kaveri)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 support, with 4 physical cores or more, ARMv8 CPU Example: Intel Core i5-6600K, AMD Ryzen 5 1600, Snapdragon X Elite
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full OpenGL 4.6 support Example: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 (Kepler), AMD Radeon HD 7750 (GCN 1.0)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: A tactical RPG combining strategy, narrative, and extensive character and skill customization, set in a medieval fantasy world inspired by the giants of the genre.
supported_languages: English, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese, French, German, Spanish - Latin America
